Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Cloud Native Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Cloud Native Developer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the role:


As a Senior Cloud Native Developer , you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, cloud-native applications using Azure and .NET technologies . You will collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality software solutions that follow modern engineering practices.

This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Azure cloud services , microservices , and backend development , combined with strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native applications using Azure services , .NET Core , and C# .
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to ensure smooth and automated deployments.
  • Define and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Pulumi .
  • Develop microservices and event-driven architectures leveraging Azure Functions , Azure Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Build and optimize RESTful APIs , ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, QA, and product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Apply best practices for monitoring , logging , and application performance management .
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience in software development with .NET Core and C# .
  • Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services , including Azure Functions , Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts , including hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi , Terraform , or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building and managing containers (Docker) and working with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of software design principles , clean code , and best engineering practices .
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work collaboratively in distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
  • Familiarity with Application Insights , Grafana , or other monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of MuleSoft or similar integration platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

title: Lead SRE Engineer
description:
About the Company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the Role

We’re seeking an experienced Lead Site Reliability Engineer to join our growing team in Brazil. In this role, you’ll partner with product teams to tackle critical infrastructure challenges, acting as both a hands-on technical expert and a mentor.

You’ll help design, build, and operate cloud platforms while driving reliability, performance, and security across the engineering organization.


Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and support engineers, foster technical excellence through code reviews and design discussions, and help unblock complex challenges.
  • Documentation & Standards: Create and maintain runbooks, standards, and best-practice guides to strengthen operational capabilities.
  • Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD: Automate provisioning and deployments using Terraform and best-practice pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, etc.).
  • Reliability Engineering: Define SLIs/SLOs, manage error budgets, and build dashboards and alerts to proactively monitor system health.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce least-privilege IAM policies, automate vulnerability scans, and maintain audit logging.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Instrument services with metrics, logs, and distributed tracing to enable rapid troubleshooting.
  • Cost Optimization: Implement tagging strategies, right-size resources, and use data-driven insights to manage cloud spend effectively.


Must Have

  • Managing production-critical systems with deep knowledge of SRE and DevOps principles .
  • Proven experience mentoring engineers and leading technical projects.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS and cloud-native best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS or GKE) and large-scale container orchestration.
  • Expertise with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
  • Experience managing and debugging Redis and Postgres databases.
  • Solid understanding of VPCs, VPNs, load balancers, and cloud networking .
  • Proficiency with Git , branching strategies, and CI/CD integrations.
  • Strong grasp of web and network protocols (HTTP, REST, TLS, DNS, etc.).


Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience breaking down large, ambiguous projects into actionable tasks.
  • Familiarity with ArgoCD , GitHub Actions , Jenkins , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Working knowledge of Python , Golang , and Helm .
  • Experience running scalable Node.js microservices.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure security and Terragrunt best practices.
  • Background in production readiness and high-growth engineering environments .


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.

title: Global Feasibility Lead II
description:
Job Overview

The Global Feasibility Lead II will play an integral role in operational strategy and planning in the preaward space through participation in strategy development conversations, robust primary and secondary data collection and analysis, and development of feasibility and site selection strategies. In addition, the Global Feasibility Lead II will be responsible for managing global feasibility projects, working closely with representatives within the company to deliver robust feasibility reports to our customers. The Global Feasibility Lead II will transition the site selection strategy to operations in the post-award space by handing over relevant pre-award findings to the site selection team. The Global Feasibility Lead II will lead and/or contribute to process improvement and change initiatives within Feasibility, alongside training opportunities for departmental requirements and any other subjects that impact on feasibility conduct. The Global Feasibility Lead 2 role requires a diverse skill set; strong data mining and analytics skills, writing and presentation skills, and customer management skills are required. Comfort with participating in and/or leading client facing interactions as it relates to presenting feasibility related findings and recommendations is necessary.


Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Accountable for supporting the development, analyses, interpretation, and presentation of primary and secondary data in support of operational strategy and planning.
  • Conducts data mining of internal and external databases and initiates/oversees the collection of primary data for use in development of robust strategies for global clinical trials (country/site mix, site selection, enrollment modeling.).
  • Participates in the development of proposals and bid defenses; provides recommendations on the most appropriate use of data to support proposals and bid defense presentations, works with the team to identify potential risks, and is learning to propose effective solutions as appropriate.
  • Actively participates on cross-functional teams that plan, analyze, and present proposals and bid defenses as part of winning new business and maintaining client base.
  • Serves as functional bidder reviewer of the budget and text for proposals for which feasibility and/or site identification is included as the primary deliverable.
  • Leads cross functional teams in standalone feasibility efforts; responsible for final report creation and delivery, including discussion of findings and recommendations with external clients.
  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.


Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

title: Electrical Supervisor
description:
Offshore Electrical Supervisor - Drillship in Brazil - Local payroll


* Offshore Experience working on a drillship or Semi is essential *


Overview


We are seeking an experienced and proactive Electrical Supervisor to oversee all electrical systems and operations onboard a drillship.

In this role, you will ensure high operational efficiency, compliance with safety standards, and support smooth offshore drilling activities. This role is critical to ensuring the continued success of our offshore operations while fostering an inclusive, safety-first work environment.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic and diverse offshore environment. Candidates with leadership capabilities, technical expertise, and experience in drilling operations are encouraged to apply.


Responsibilities

  • Supervise the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of onboard electrical systems, including complex drilling and offshore equipment.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety regulations, electrical codes, and offshore operation standards.
  • Coordinate with the drilling and mechanical teams to ensure seamless integration of electrical systems in daily operations.
  • Develop, review, and update maintenance schedules for electrical equipment and systems.
  • Conduct routine inspections and testing of all electrical systems to identify and address potential hazards or failures.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and training to a diverse team of electricians and support crew members.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and implement long-term solutions for system efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate records of electrical works, inspections, breakdowns, and necessary upgrades for equipment.
  • Contribute to the safety culture on the drillship by adhering to and promoting a safe work environment, including performing safety audits and toolbox talks.
  • Work within teams to prepare for emergencies and respond promptly to electrical system failures or incidents.


Experience :

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a supervisor role, preferably on a drillship or semi-submersible
  • Strong understanding of marine electrical systems, offshore drilling equipment, and high-voltage systems.
  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in troubleshooting electrical systems, managing control panels, and handling PLC systems.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of international offshore standards, electrical codes, and safety regulations.
  • Proven ability to lead and work with diverse teams in high-pressure and dynamic environments.
  • Physical fitness to work in an offshore setting, with appropriate certifications (e.g., BOSIET, HUET, or OGUK Medical Certificate).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to ensure effective collaboration across teams.


Day-to-day

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair electrical systems to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Oversee electrical team members, assigning tasks and providing technical guidance as needed.
  • Communicate with the drilling and operations team to address any immediate power or system issues affecting performance.
  • Monitor and report electrical maintenance progress to onboard management and onshore support teams.
  • Document all findings during inspections and repairs, updating maintenance logs accordingly.
  • Provide mentorship to less-experienced team members, fostering an inclusive and supportive learning environment.

Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Desenvolvedor IA
description:
Somos uma empresa do Grupo Stefanini. Especializados em marketing digital, utilizamos uma abordagem integrada que combina tecnologia, inteligência de dados, design e profundo conhecimento do comportamento do consumidor. Nosso foco está em potencializar os resultados de nossos parceiros, oferecendo soluções que vão desde consultoria estratégica até a execução e acompanhamento dos projetos. Com um time dedicado e altamente qualificado, a Gauge se destaca por sua capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas de cada cliente e entregar resultados de alta performance.

Com forte presença na América Latina e em expansão nos Estados Unidos, estamos sempre na vanguarda, aplicando as últimas tendências de mercado e mantendo um olhar atento à inovação contínua.


DESENVOLVEDOR IA


Como Desenvolvedor Sr / Especialista de IA “Hands On”, você atuará em parceria com a equipe de desenvolvimento, não apenas liderando, mas também contribuindo ativamente para a codificação e implementação de soluções inovadoras. Sua experiência técnica e sua paixão pela IA serão essenciais para guiar o time na criação de soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho.



Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de software utilizando tecnologias de inteligência artificial.
  • Trabalhar com algoritmos e técnicas específicas de IA, incluindo NLP e aprendizado de máquina.
  • Implementar soluções de IA utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Utilizar frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain, para desenvolver soluções escaláveis.
  • Implementar soluções de NLP com ferramentas como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Realizar pré-processamento de texto, incluindo tokenização, criação de embeddings e remoção de stop words.
  • Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Porte (LLMs), como GPT e Llama, aplicando melhores práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolver aplicações web utilizando frameworks como FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Colaborar na implementação de soluções utilizando MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para a implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Participar de processos de HAG (Hiper-Agilidade) para garantir entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Integrar e otimizar embeddings para melhorar a performance das soluções de IA.
  • Mentorizar e apoiar os membros da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado e colaboração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência com N8N é obrigatória.
  • Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e otimização de embeddings.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de software para aplicações de inteligência artificial.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js ou Go.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain.
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de NLP, como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experiência em pré-processamento de texto e implementação de LLMs.
  • Vivência em arquiteturas de software escaláveis e de alto desempenho voltadas para IA.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web com FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Experiência com MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe e boa comunicação.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Seniority : Lead

Location : Remote (LATAM preferred)

Contract Type : Full-time Contractor

Start Date : Early to mid-November 2025

Duration : 6 months (with the possibility of extension)

Schedule : Must be available between 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM EST


We’re looking for a Lead Fullstack Engineer to take technical ownership of two web-based products currently in development. This is a hands-on leadership role that blends architecture, coding, and collaboration. You’ll guide the project's direction, make key technical decisions, and ensure the delivery of reliable, scalable, and well-built software.


We’re looking for someone proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working directly with product and design teams. You’ll be part of a small, talented group focused on building high-quality tools that make a real impact.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design, implementation, and delivery of multiple web applications.
  • Work closely with product and design to turn requirements into well-structured, maintainable solutions.
  • Write clean, high-quality code using Node.js, React, and TypeScript.
  • Design and optimize databases using PostgreSQL.
  • Build and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure using AWS (ECS, EKS, S3, RDS).
  • Manage integrations with external platforms, including SSO and Okta.
  • Ensure performance, reliability, and security best practices are applied throughout the stack.
  • Support and mentor other developers, helping improve processes and code quality.


Requirements

  • Strong experience with Node.js, React, and TypeScript (+5 years).
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL.
  • Proven experience leading a team.
  • Proven experience deploying and maintaining applications on AWS (ECS, EKS, S3, RDS).
  • Comfortable with serverless architectures and microservices.
  • Experience integrating third-party tools and identity providers (SSO, Okta, etc.).
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and make thoughtful technical decisions.
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have

  • Experience in the education technology sector or other large-scale, user-facing platforms.
  • Familiarity with Azure or Google Cloud.
  • Prior experience as a Tech Lead or Engineering Manager.
  • Strong eye for quality, UX, and performance.


Why Join

  • Lead the technical direction of growing products from an early stage.
  • Work in a fast-paced, fully remote environment with a high level of autonomy.
  • Collaborate with a passionate and professional team.

title: Técnico de Elétrica e Instrumentação e Automação
description:
CARGO:

Técnico de Elétrica e Instrumentação e Automação


RESUMO DA FUNÇÃO:

Responsável por garantir a confiabilidade e a integração dos sistemas elétricos, de instrumentação e automação, acompanhando, comissionando e executando serviços conforme projetos, normas técnicas e procedimentos da empresa.


RESPONSABILIDADES:

Acompanhar as frentes de serviço, garantindo que os trabalhos sejam executados conforme os projetos, normas técnicas e procedimentos da empresa;

Comissionar as atividades de pré-operação (utilizando as características técnicas dos equipamentos dar partida nas operações em campo junto com os representantes quando for o caso);

Interpretar projetos elétricos, diagramas e esquemas técnicos, repassando as instruções à equipe de trabalho;

Executar testes e operações elétricas ou de instrumentação ou de comunicação das automações necessárias em sistemas supervisórios e centrais de alarme;

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

Formação técnica em Elétrica, Mecânica, Instrumentação, Eletrotécnica e/ou áreas correlacionadas, com registro ativo;

Experiência com sistemas de operação com motores utilizando soft-starter, inversores, sistemas de automação utilizando PLC, operação de sistemas de automação utilizando cabos de rede MODBUS, ETHERNET;

Conhecimento para testes na área de comissionamento utilizando equipamentos de medição, tais como: HI-POT, MEGGER, parametrização e calibração de relés de proteção de acordo com cálculos de seletividade em instalações elétricas.

Local: Benfica – Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Horário: 5x2 (ADM)

Salário: A combinar

Benefícios: Vale Alimentação + Refeição no Local + Seguro de Vida + Assistência Médica + Vale Transporte

title: Arquiteto SAP Commerce (Hybris)
description:
Arquiteto SAP Commerce (Hybris)

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior / Especialista


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto SAP Commerce (Hybris) experiente para atuar na definição e sustentação da arquitetura de soluções de e-commerce em ambiente SAP. O profissional será responsável por garantir o desempenho, escalabilidade e integração do SAP Commerce com demais sistemas corporativos, além de apoiar o time técnico em decisões de arquitetura e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

O papel requer forte base técnica, visão estratégica e experiência consolidada em projetos complexos de SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris , atuando de forma colaborativa com equipes de desenvolvimento, negócio e infraestrutura.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura técnica e funcional das soluções baseadas em SAP Commerce (Hybris).
  • Garantir a integração eficiente do Commerce com SAP ERP / S/4HANA , SAP CPI e demais sistemas legados.
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na adoção de boas práticas de código, performance e segurança .
  • Conduzir análises de impacto, revisões técnicas e troubleshooting de alto nível.
  • Definir estratégias de deploy, versionamento e ambientes de homologação/produção .
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e funcionais, apoiando o time de produto e negócios em decisões arquiteturais.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, orientando desenvolvedores e garantindo a aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto ou Desenvolvedor Sênior SAP Commerce (Hybris) .
  • Sólido domínio em Java, Spring Framework e arquitetura RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) e/ou ambientes On-Premise.
  • Conhecimento em integrações com SAP ERP ou SAP S/4HANA , utilizando SAP CPI ou APIs customizadas.
  • Experiência em projetos de e-commerce B2B e B2C .
  • Vivência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git), automação (Jenkins, SonarQube) e metodologias ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com microservices , API management e arquiteturas em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) .
  • Certificação SAP Commerce ou SAP Certified Development Professional – SAP Commerce Cloud.
  • Conhecimento em soluções de front-end (Angular, React) integradas ao SAP Commerce.
  • Experiência prévia em grandes ambientes corporativos ou projetos internacionais.

title: SRE Analyst
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Sênior para fortalecer a base técnica que sustenta nossa plataforma de dados financeiros. Como SRE na Gorila, você será peça-chave na construção e evolução de uma infraestrutura escalável, observável e resiliente, garantindo que nossos sistemas possam crescer com segurança e agilidade — sem perder o foco em qualidade, performance e confiabilidade.


Você atuará diretamente no suporte à nossa missão: entregar clareza e controle para investidores e instituições através de dados financeiros bem tratados, acessíveis e confiáveis. Isso significa garantir que os pipelines de dados estejam sempre disponíveis, que os sistemas sejam fáceis de operar e monitorar, e que o time de engenharia possa inovar com autonomia e confiança.


No dia a dia, você será responsável por liderar iniciativas de automação, infraestrutura como código, práticas de GitOps e observabilidade, utilizando ferramentas como Kubernetes (EKS), ArgoCD, Crossplane, Istio, Grafana e Prometheus. Seu trabalho será essencial para garantir que nossa plataforma continue sendo uma referência em confiabilidade, tanto para investidores individuais quanto para grandes instituições financeiras que consomem nossos dados via integrações e APIs.


Responsabilidades

Projetar, implementar e manter a infraestrutura baseada em AWS e Kubernetes (EKS)

Criar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitHub Actions e ArgoCD

Implementar e gerenciar observabilidade com Grafana, Prometheus, Loki e Tempo

Garantir a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura, incluindo controle de acesso, rede e comunicação entre serviços com Istio

Automatizar a criação e gerenciamento de recursos na AWS com Terraform, Crossplane e Kustomization


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Experiência com AWS e serviços como EKS, RDS, IAM, S3, entre outros

Conhecimento sólido em redes, protocolos de comunicação, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, TLS e roteamento

Forte conhecimento em Kubernetes e ferramentas de gerenciamento de infraestrutura

Experiência com ArgoCD e GitOps

Conhecimento avançado em observabilidade e tracing distribuído

Experiência com Istio ou outra solução de Service Mesh

Experiência com automação e infraestrutura como código (Crossplane, Kustomization, Terraform, etc.)

Conhecimento em CI/CD com GitHub Actions ou similares

Experiência em troubleshooting e otimização de PostgreSQL em produção

Conhecimento em scripting (Bash, Python ou Go) para automação

Experiência com práticas de FinOps


Diferenciais:

Experiência com security hardening em ambientes Kubernetes

Experiência com Open Policy Agent ou similares

Experiência com banco de dados PostgreSQL, garantindo alta disponibilidade e otimização de desempenho

Experiência em gerenciamento de Operadores de Bancos de Dados no Kubernetes como CloudNativePG e Zalando

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

title: Application Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Application Project Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


Job Description:

The Application Project Manager will drive the delivery and management of IT applications throughout their lifecycle. This role is essential to ensure the effectiveness, security and innovation of the applications, contributing to the overall technological advancement and operational efficiency of the organization. The professional must possess a distinct combination of business, IT, financial, and communication skills.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Project Management: Developing detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Ensure the timely and successful delivery of IT projects, meeting defined goals and expectations.
  • Leadership and People Management: Lead and inspire project teams, promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Provide support, guidance, and mentorship to team members, encouraging their professional growth.
  • Stakeholder Management: Developing and maintaining strong relationships with all project stakeholders, ensuring that their needs and expectations are understood and managed effectively.
  • Resource Management and Budget: Allocate and manage resources effectively to ensure project delivery within scope, deadline, and budget constraints. Develop and manage the project budget, seeking to optimize expenses and minimize the total cost of ownership.
  • Supplier and Contract Management: Collaborate and negotiate with suppliers, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure successful completion.
  • Quality Assurance and Compliance: Implement rigorous testing and quality assurance protocols. Ensure that all project activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, and organizational policies.


Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 11 to 15 years of experience. More than 10 years of experience in IT project management with a focus on application development and deployment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Tools: Proficiency in project management software such as MS Project, Jira, Trello . Knowledge of reporting and analysis tools to track metrics and project performance.
  • Methodologies: Familiarity with project management methodologies such as PMI, PRINCE2 and Agile approaches.

Soft Skills:

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Leadership: Strong leadership qualities to guide and motivate teams.
  • Conflict Resolution: Proficiency in identifying and resolving conflicts through effective mediation and negotiation techniques.
  • Negotiation Skill and Influence: Effective negotiation skills for dealing with contracts. Ability to influence in an environment where paper does not directly control resources.
  • Adaptation: Ability to adapt to new circumstances in a changing business environment.
  • Customer Focus: A customer-centric approach to understanding and meeting needs effectively.
  • Languages: English and/or French are considered an asset.


Expected Skills:

  • Lead and motivate teams, demonstrating empathy.
  • Maintain a high level of expertise in IT applications and systems.
  • Oversee the integration of various IT applications to ensure operation and security.
  • Evaluate and recommend technical solutions that align with business needs.
  • Establish and manage customer expectations.
  • Develop and execute a resource plan to ensure that the right people are in the right place, doing the right things at the right time.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or equivalent. Scrum Master certification or equivalent Agile certification.
  • Education: Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Knowledge: Strong knowledge of ITIL practices. Knowledge of current and emerging technologies.

title: Staff Accountant (Netsuite)
description:
SUMMARY


INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role plays a key part in supporting Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on experience with NetSuite, and enjoys working in a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within the NetSuite system.


PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES


NetSuite Accounting Data Management


  • Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite.
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of all accounting entries in NetSuite across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll modules.
  • Conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues.
  • Support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.


Testing & System Validation


  • Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules:
  • Validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll.
  • Perform UAT (User Acceptance Testing) during NetSuite updates or enhancements.
  • Work closely with the Accounting, Finance, and IT teams to identify and troubleshoot accounting-related system errors or configuration gaps.
  • Help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.


Month-End & Operational Support


  • Support the month-end close process by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite.
  • Assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports to support financial review.
  • Ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.


Documentation & Internal Support


  • Maintain accurate documentation of system processes, data input standards, and workflows within NetSuite.
  • Assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


KEY COMPETENCIES


  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite ERP and accounting module navigation.
  • Understanding of US GAAP accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative accounting team.
  • Capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting data manipulation.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on strong experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
  • Experience working with accounting data across modules like AR, AP, GL, and Payroll.


WHAT WE OFFER


  • Remote work opportunity.
  • Working hours 8-5 EST (preferred).
  • Monthly gross salary within the range of $1000-$2200.
  • Participating in our "One Window - One Tree" initiative.
  • The opportunity to improve your skills through professional development training.
  • A rapidly growing company.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: Water & Sanitation Expert
description:
Join Mútua as a Short-Term Expert Reviewer for the Water & Sanitation System Transition in Latin America


Are you a researcher, consultant, or practitioner with deep expertise in the sustainability transitions of Water & Sanitation systems in Latin America?


Mútua is bringing together a select group of qualified experts for a short-term, paid engagement to collectively review the content of our intelligence platform—created to support funders seeking to accelerate the transition toward a more regenerative, equitable, and resilient water & sanitation system in the region.


About the Role


This is a temporary expert engagement, compensated on an hourly basis (with rates to be agreed upon individually). As a contributor, you will help refine and validate the knowledge embedded in our platform, ensuring it accurately reflects strategic priorities, transition pathways, and systemic leverage points relevant to water & sanitation in Latin America.


We are looking for individuals with a systems-informed perspective on:


  • Key transition pathways for equitable and sustainable water & sanitation access
  • Interventions linking water security, public health, livelihoods and climate resilience
  • The role of policy, finance, innovation, and grassroots action in driving transformation


Whether your experience is in integrated water resource management, rural and urban sanitation, water justice, climate-resilient infrastructure, or water governance—your insights will help funders better identify and support transformative initiatives.


About Mútua


Mútua is an AI-powered intelligence platform that connects mission-driven funders—from philanthropic foundations to impact investors—with innovators such as startups, NGOs, and research institutions. We align capital with systemic solutions in critical systems like food, healthcare, and energy.


By transforming fragmented impact data into actionable intelligence, we empower funders to make faster, more strategic, and more impactful decisions.


Who We’re Looking For


We invite applications from Water & Sanitation experts with:


  • Proven knowledge and experience in water & sanitation systems in Latin America
  • A strong grasp of systemic and cross-sectoral dynamics
  • The ability to provide strategic and constructive feedback on frameworks, content, and priorities


Fluency in English is required, as all content to be reviewed is written in English.


This is a remote, flexible opportunity. We welcome applicants based across the Americas and Europe.


If you're committed to shaping the future of food, agriculture, and land in Latin America—and want to contribute to a tool that mobilizes capital for systemic change—we’d love to hear from you.

  • work experience.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

  • Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Telepatia

Telepatia AI is building an AI Doctor to radically improve healthcare. We recently raised the largest LatAm seed round of $9M, backed by top global investors. Our team comes from Stanford, Microsoft, MD Anderson, Houston Methodist, and Alice, and we’re on a mission to transform how clinical data is captured and used.

Healthcare has two fundamental sources of truth: images and conversations. While most technology has focused on images, 99% of real medical decisions are made through voice. Telepatia is capturing that voice data and turning it into structured, reliable clinical intelligence—unlocking the foundation for an AI-first healthcare system.

We are assembling one of the most talent-dense technical teams in Latin America, with the ambition of building the “Manhattan Project” of AI in healthcare.


Mission of the Role

As an AI Engineer at Telepatia , your mission is to design, build, and deploy AI systems that turn unstructured clinical conversations into structured, reliable medical intelligence. You’ll work across the stack—from backend Python microservices and LLM orchestration to lightweight front-ends and data pipelines—integrating the latest in AI research into production workflows used by doctors daily.

You’ll be part of a small, elite team where each engineer’s output directly impacts the accuracy of our AI systems, the speed of our clinical documentation, and ultimately, patient care across Latin America. This is a role for builders who want to ship fast, work with autonomy, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in applied AI.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and scale Python microservices (FastAPI) that handle real-time inference and structured data processing.
  • Build AI agent pipelines for reasoning, orchestration, and multi-step workflows using tools like LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Develop data pipelines and eval dashboards to monitor, analyze, and improve AI model performance.
  • Collaborate closely with clinicians, product managers, and software engineers to turn ambiguous requests into production-ready AI features—often in less than a day.
  • Integrate models and pipelines into our core Medical Scribe product to enhance automation, reliability, and doctor experience.
  • Contribute to key technical decisions around LLM infrastructure, evaluation, scalability, and deployment.


Must-Haves

  • Strong backend experience in Python , with a focus on microservices (FastAPI preferred).
  • Experience building at the AI application layer : LLM orchestration, agents, and pipelines (LangChain, CrewAI, or similar).
  • Frontend familiarity with React/Tailwind or Flutter for rapid prototyping and data visualization.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and evaluation dashboards for AI models.
  • High product velocity: you prioritize shipping value quickly over theoretical perfection.
  • Ability to take ambiguous, non-technical requests and turn them into working production features in less than a day.
  • Strong ownership mindset, curiosity, and comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in hard sciences such as Physics or Mathematics .
  • Experience with vector databases , RAG architectures , or model evaluation frameworks .
  • Prior work with healthcare data , EHR systems , or HIPAA/LGPD compliance.
  • Prior startup experience in high-growth or early-stage environments.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Buscamos #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Domínio avançado em Java (versão 11+) e tecnologias do ecossistema, incluindo streams, lambdas, módulos, records, pattern matching, além de proficiência em Spring (Boot, Security, Data, Cloud, WebFlux).

  • Atuação com serverless utilizando AWS Lambda, incluindo otimização de cold start, runtime customizado, design e integração de APIs (RESTful/WebSocket), além de práticas como throttling, caching e mensageria (SQS/SNS).

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!
