title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

title: Software Engineer Sênior

O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.

  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage


(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)


Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance


Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.


We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)

  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus


Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering


Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. title: : Senior Software Engineer – Infrastructure
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.



Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.

Who We Are

WebCreek provides world- class software development teams and technical staff augmentation to Fortune 500 companies and other global industry leaders. With over 29 years of experience and a global presence spanning 20+ offices across North America, Latin America, Asia, and Europe, we deliver top-tier digital solutions to the companies that power the world.

title: Financial Analyst, Acquisitions
description:
Company

Homestead Communities (the “Company”) addresses the affordable housing crisis in the United States by providing safe, clean and supportive communities where working families and retirees can own or rent affordable, high-quality, single-family manufactured homes.  Founded in 2023, the Company was one of the ten largest buyers of manufactured housing communities (“MHC”) over the past two years. Homestead Communities is committed to responsible stewardship for its residents, providing engaging careers for its team members, and delivering attractive risk-adjusted returns to its investor. 

Homestead Communities is owned by its management team and one of the world’s largest, publicly-traded, international real estate investors. The Company combines proven, growth-orientated entrepreneurial leadership with institutional discipline and financial capability. This position offers the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a new enterprise with proven partners and the resources and experience to build a significant operating business.

Location

Anywhere in Brasil, (or Latin America).  The position is home-based.


Position Overview

The Financial Analyst, Acquisitions will use the Company’s financial model to project cash flows for potential acquisitions. Projections include initial capital, financing, and monthly operating income and expenses. Projections depend on analysis of MHC’s historic financial statements, current rent roll, and primary market research, all lead by the Financial Analyst, Acquisitions.  Further financial analysis, which may require additional market or property diligence, is typically needed to respond to property-specific questions and unique investment characteristics.

The position can be full-time or a minimum commitment of 25 hours weekly. If part-time, the candidate must have flexibility to meet carrying deadlines for workflow. The daily time commitment will vary with the Company’s deal flow. There will be times when there are multiple transactions at the same time and times when there are short deadlines.  There will be times between transactions that the Financial Analyst, Acquisitions will assist in broader work related to acquisitions.

Responsibilities

·        Prepare cash flow projections for proposed acquisitions.

o   Detailed, monthly projections for ten-year hold period. Dozens of line-items used to specify assumptions and clearly calculate resulting values.

o   The Vice President, Acquisitions provides initial underwriting assumptions, sets deadlines, and provides quality assurance review. 

o   Review and understand historic financial statements from a MHC seller and/or broker.

o   Prepare return sensitivities to varying operating assumptions.

·        Research the competitive housing market of potential MHC acquisitions.

o   Identify comparable MHCs and call MHCs to determine their occupancy, rental rates, amenities, and housing stock.

o   Review rental rates for competitive apartments and single-family homes. Review sales values and absorption of for-sale single-family homes in the submarket.

·        Prepare Investment Committee memoranda summarizing the potential investment.

·        Supervise updates to various proprietary databases used in the acquisitions workflow.

o   Master MHC property and owner lists.

o   CRM lists and programs.

o   MHC sales comps through database searches and contact with MHC brokers.

·        Track trends in AI and SaaS tools that could further automate the Company’s acquisition process.


Reporting

·        Reports to and will be supported by our Vice President, Acquisitions. 

·       Consults with senior team members to refine operating assumptions (operating and capital expenses).


Advancement

·        The candidate will get broad exposure to the acquisition, management and ownership of MHCs. 

·   Broader financial analysis and coding opportunities exist if they fit the experience and interest of the candidate.

·        Further opportunities may include broader responsibilities sourcing and supporting acquisitions.

Qualifications

·        Expert in Microsoft Excel and comfortable with basic math functions. (Calculus is useless.)  Thorough understanding of income statements and balance sheets.

·        Work experience at minimum in summer internships in residential or commercial real estate brokerage, lending, investment or consulting; private equity; investment banking; or accounting. One or two years of full-time employment is desirable but not required. More familiarity with residential real estate is preferred.

·        Fluent in English.

Compensation

·        Annual salary highly competitive for the location and qualifications of the candidate.

·        Annual cash bonus target of 10% of total annual salary depending on the achievement of mutually-agreed goals.

title: Head of Compliance
description:
Head de Compliance — Reborn

Remoto | Full-time | Remuneração competitiva + bônus

A Reborn  é infra de pagamentos feita por quem executa. A gente roda volume real, em múltiplos nichos, com risco alto e crescimento mais alto ainda. Procuramos um(a) Head de Compliance sênior  para liderar a construção da nossa estrutura de Compliance, Risco e AML  — sem travar o crescimento.

O desafio

Arquitetar e operar, ponta a ponta, KYC/KYB, AML, antifraude, onboarding e monitoramento transacional . Integrar compliance dentro do produto  (no código, não só no papel), garantindo aderência a BACEN/LGPD/PCI e governança de nível enterprise.

Responsabilidades
  • Desenhar políticas e processos de onboarding, PLD-FT, retenções e chargeback .
  • Implantar rule engine , alertas, listas restritivas e investigações internas.

O que oferecemos
  • Remuneração competitiva + bônus por performance .

  • Remoto-first , time de alta performance, zero politicagem.
  • Contexto de crescimento acelerado  e impacto direto no core do negócio.
Como se candidatar

Envie CV + cases (com números)  para 


Assunto: Head de Compliance — (Seu Nome)

title: Data Architect
description:
About the Product:

Job Purpose:

Duties and Responsibilities:

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.


Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.


Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.


Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.

title: Quality and Engineering Specialist
description:
About us:


DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.


About the job:


The Specialist in the Quality and Engineering department is a highly experienced professional who takes a leadership role in quality management and technical reference. They are responsible for overseeing and directing high complex quality control processes, leading strategic improvements, and ensuring the company’s adherence to industry’s best practices and regulatory requirements.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Assist to oversee quality control and engineering processes for the landing gear MRO.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive quality improvement programs to enhance operational performance.
  • Technical guidance for analysts, ensuring compliance with internal procedures, manuals and best practices.
  • Perform advanced analysis of data, lead root cause investigations, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage and ensure compliance with all aerospace regulations, quality certifications (ANAC, FAA, ISO 9001, etc.) and approved technical data (CMMs and other manufacture manuals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including operations, supply chain and planning to ensure seamless quality management.
  • Support internal and external audits, providing technical support and assistance during regulatory inspections and certifications.
  • Develop and report on key quality performance indicators, identifying areas for process optimization and cost reduction.
  • Be the technical reference in strategic decision-making regarding quality and process improvements.


Work Experience:


+5 Years of experience working in an aeronautical industry with quality and/or engineering.

Strong experience with quality auditing process (aeronautical authorities (FAA, ANAC, EASA), supplier qualification and aeronautical departments).


Educational:

Technical degree or Graduation (Engineering, Quality or Technical) concluded with Post graduation/ master’s degree in concluded.

Advanced / Fluent English is mandatory


Technical Skills:

Advanced quality tools, drawing interpretations (development is a plus), in-depth knowledge of aeronautical authorities’ regulations (FAA, EASA, ANAC) and ISO 9001 standard or related audit standard requirements.


Obs.: Office and shop floor setting in a regulated aerospace maintenance facility.

May require occasional hands-on inspections or shop visits involving PPE and exposure to aircraft components and tooling.

Work may involve tight deadlines and collaboration across departments.


Location:


100% in office position at Rio de Janeiro.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About Ótmow

Ótmow is a fast-growing fintech startup reshaping financial access for companies that work with the Brazilian government. We empower these businesses with seamless, secure, and accessible financial solutions in order to provide essential government services with confidence.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who treats AI as a partner, not just a tool. You’ll build end-to-end features across the stack while creatively leveraging AI to accelerate development, automate workflows, and design scalable, flexible systems.

You’ll work in a fast-moving environment focused on transforming complex data into intelligent products. From building a credit matrix and automating sales/marketing workflows to designing dashboards and public-data scrapers, you’ll directly shape Ótmow’s core technology.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain features using React (TypeScript) and Python (FastAPI or Flask) .
  • Collaborate with AI tools (GPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.) to speed up coding, automate tasks, and improve quality.
  • Design and execute web scraping jobs to extract structured data from public transparency portals.
  • Develop and integrate infrastructure on GCP (Cloud Run, Firestore, Firebase Auth) and Supabase (PostgreSQL) .
  • Implement product features such as credit matrices, automation tools, and performance dashboards.
  • Ensure data integrity and quality across systems.
  • Actively participate in architecture design, code reviews, and planning sessions.
  • Experiment with emerging AI models and evaluate their potential for development, automation, and decision support.


Required Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript and React .
  • Solid experience with Python and backend frameworks (FastAPI, Flask ).
  • Experience with web scraping (Playwright, BeautifulSoup, requests).
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and version control (Git, CI/CD) .
  • Fluency in AI-assisted development tools such as GPT, Claude, Cursor, etc.
  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly in a remote setup.
  • Advanced English (for documentation and discussions) and Native Portuguese (for technical and business communication).
  • Ability to work under Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) in Brazil.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience scraping dynamic websites or handling anti-bot systems.
  • Background in data-driven products or credit/fintech platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI APIs or model fine-tuning.
  • Experience automating developer workflows using AI tools.


Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a company at the intersection of fintech, data, and AI , redefining how public-sector suppliers access credit in Brazil, to build impactful, scalable solutions. And more ...

  • Competitive salary + performance bonuses.
  • Potential for equity participation, sharing in Ótmow’s long-term success.
  • Opportunity to transform a traditional sector with cutting-edge fintech solutions.
  • Flexible hours and remote-friendly culture.
  • Join a collaborative, diverse global team where different backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas drive innovation.

title: Product Owner
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Sobre a área:

A área de Produto Digital é responsável por evoluir os produtos da empresa, garantindo alta performance, experiência do usuário diferenciada e integração com os demais. Temos como objetivo aumentar a adoção, engajamento e satisfação dos usuários, assegurando entregas alinhadas às estratégias de negócio e à qualidade técnica esperada.


Principais atividades:

Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos.

Análise de mercado e Bench com identificação de tendências de aplicativos e canais digitais.

Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e critérios de aceitação claros.

Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras. Tomar decisões de Go/No Go da entrega na Review;

Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões

Conduzir refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas seguindo metodologias ágeis.

Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades junto aos usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.

Gerenciar os stakeholders e garantir a comunicação (estratégias e ações).



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Necessário graduação completa.

Necessário domínio do Pacote Office.

Necessário conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio a gestão de projetos e produtos.

Necessário conhecimento em Scrum e frameworks ágeis.

Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou posição similar, com atuação em produtos digitais.

Vivência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis (iOS e Android).

Habilidade em análise de métricas de produto (Firebase, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).

Boa comunicação e capacidade de articular diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar na gestão de aplicativos digitais , com foco especial no aplicativo de resultados de exames , garantindo priorização assertiva das demandas e interlocução com diferentes áreas e regionais. Procuramos alguém com experiência avançada em aplicativos digitais , que seja articulada, saiba se posicionar com clareza e tenha facilidade em conduzir conversas estratégicas com diferentes públicos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad , garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da área. Também terá atuação próxima do time digital localizado em São Paulo , influenciando e direcionando prioridades de forma indireta e estruturada.

Buscamos alguém com conhecimento aprofundado sobre as lojas da Apple e Google , incluindo políticas, publicações e boas práticas de atualização de aplicativos.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e com critérios de aceitação claros.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de negócio, UX/UI e desenvolvimento para definir soluções funcionais e inovadoras.
  • Realizar análise de mercado e benchmarking para identificar tendências em aplicativos e canais digitais.
  • Acompanhar métricas de uso, performance e engajamento para embasar decisões.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (refinamentos, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas).
  • Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades com usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders e garantir a comunicação clara sobre estratégias e ações.

Se você tem perfil estratégico, domínio de aplicativos digitais e gosta de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e orientada a resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.



Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Power BI Developer
description:
Company Overview

Our client is a leading Project Portfolio Management (PPM) software company helping organizations deliver complex projects with speed and precision. As part of their growth, they seek a skilled Power BI Developer to join their product and engineering teams, driving our reporting and analytics capabilities to the next level.


Role Overview

You will be the primary Power BI authority, embedded within the product team and reporting directly to the Head of Product. Unlike legacy reporting roles, this position demands holistic thinking at the data model level, structuring interlinked datasets, and designing reports that deliver insight and impact. You will bring both technical rigor and visual finesse, turning raw data into compelling stories that support better decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain sophisticated Power BI dashboards and reports tailored to customer needs, reflecting strong narrative design principles.
  • Develop and manage embedded Power BI analytics solutions within our proprietary PPM software platform.
  • Architect and implement semantic data models in Power BI, integrating with Databricks and ensuring logical taxonomy for all datasets.
  • Write advanced PowerQuery scripts and DAX calculations for complex data transformation and analytics scenarios as needed.
  • Conduct thorough data QA, validating key metrics between our PPM platform, Databricks, and Power BI outputs.
  • Leverage SQL to extract, transform, and validate data. Understanding our integrations between Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Azure Databricks, and Power BI.
  • Optimize dashboard performance with a deep understanding of Import mode vs. Direct Query trade‑offs.
  • Power BI workspace management, external user access, and governance best practices for secure reporting.
  • Collaborate in an Azure cloud environment with engineers and architects to ensure smooth data delivery pipelines.


Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Proven ability to blend technical data modeling expertise with sharp visual storytelling instincts.
  • Experience in PPM or project management software reporting environments.
  • Familiarity with Databricks Delta Sharing and cross‑organization data collaboration.
  • Success in working independently with minimal supervision in high‑autonomy roles.
  • Strong cross‑functional communication skills, fluent in English.
  • Previous experience collaborating with remote/offshore technical teams.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Power BI, including PowerQuery, DAX, and semantic modeling.
  • 2+ years of experience building Embedded Power BI Analytics solutions and managing advanced workspace functionality.
  • Proficient in SQL and comfortable moving data across cloud platforms (OCI, Databricks, Azure).
  • Demonstrated success in conducting data QA and optimizing report performance.
  • Solid understanding of Import mode, Direct Query, workspace management, and governance protocols in Power BI.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo:

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.


Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.


Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.


Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.


Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.


O que fazemos:

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de  R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.


Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas/bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.


Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.


Prêmios e reconhecimentos: 

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S/A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.


Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas


Local de trabalho: 

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.


Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ


Requisitos mínimos:

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.


O que valorizamos:

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e/ou carteira de clientes ativa.


—


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.


Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

title: Mobility & Logistics Expert
description:
Join Mútua as a Short-Term Expert Reviewer for the Mobility & Logistics System Transition in Latin America


Are you a researcher, consultant, or practitioner with deep expertise in the sustainability transitions of Mobility & Logistics systems in Latin America?


Mútua is bringing together a select group of qualified experts for a short-term, paid engagement to collectively review the content of our intelligence platform—created to support funders seeking to accelerate the transition toward a more regenerative, equitable, and resilient Mobility & Logistics system in the region.


About the Role


This is a temporary expert engagement, compensated on an hourly basis (with rates to be agreed upon individually). As a contributor, you will help refine and validate the knowledge embedded in our platform, ensuring it accurately reflects strategic priorities, transition pathways, and systemic leverage points relevant to Mobility & Logistics in Latin America.


We are looking for individuals with a systems-informed perspective on:


  • Key transition pathways for equitable and sustainable mobility & logistics access
  • Interventions linking transportation access, economic opportunity, public health and climate resilience
  • The role of policy, finance, innovation, and grassroots action in driving transformation


Whether your experience is in sustainable urban mobility, freight and supply chain logistics, transport equity, climate-resilient infrastructure, or mobility governance—your insights will help funders better identify and support transformative initiatives.


About Mútua


Mútua is an AI-powered intelligence platform that connects mission-driven funders—from philanthropic foundations to impact investors—with innovators such as startups, NGOs, and research institutions. We align capital with systemic solutions in critical systems like food, healthcare, and energy.


By transforming fragmented impact data into actionable intelligence, we empower funders to make faster, more strategic, and more impactful decisions.


Who We’re Looking For


We invite applications from Mobility & Logistics experts with:


  • Proven knowledge and experience in mobility & logistics systems in Latin America
  • A strong grasp of systemic and cross-sectoral dynamics
  • The ability to provide strategic and constructive feedback on frameworks, content, and priorities


Fluency in English is required, as all content to be reviewed is written in English.


This is a remote, flexible opportunity. We welcome applicants based across the Americas and Europe.


If you're committed to shaping the future of food, agriculture, and land in Latin America—and want to contribute to a tool that mobilizes capital for systemic change—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Data Scientist altamente qualificado(a) e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de analytics avançado. Nesta função, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de recomendação, modelos de previsão de séries temporais e soluções de machine learning baseadas em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis e soluções escaláveis.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar sistemas de recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, baseada em conteúdo, abordagens híbridas).
  • Construir e validar modelos de previsão de séries temporais utilizando técnicas tradicionais e de machine learning (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, etc.).
  • Implementar algoritmos de boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) e árvores de decisão para diversas tarefas de aprendizado supervisionado.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e engenheiros de ML para implantar modelos em ambientes Azure e Databricks.
  • Realizar exploração de dados, engenharia de features e avaliação de modelos.
  • Apresentar descobertas e modelos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as mais recentes ferramentas e metodologias aplicadas em machine learning.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Matemática, Estatística, Física ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada com sistemas de recomendação e modelos de séries temporais.
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem Azure e Databricks.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito).

In this role, the candidate is responsible developing & maintaining ETL/ELD ingestion, API, Web and cloud systems, that deliver real time Railroad data to customers.

  • Document the design, implementation, and operation of the systems.
  • Architect and maintain front end web applications.

  • Experience maintaining and developing new features in Ruby on Rails web applications, particularly those used for software and model simulation management.
  • Experience in backend development with a modern programming language such as Python.

  • Strong knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience building and deploying high-quality front-end web applications in Angular/Vue, React.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with video streaming services.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
  • Familiarity with Java SpringBoot.

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.


Language:

Advanced English. Direct interface with global teams. Reporting to a Manager in the US.


Soft Skills:

  • Compatibility with Our Values in Action (Caterpillar Code of Conduct);

Doutorado completo Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Análise de Sistemas, Sistemas da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Dados, Tecnologia ou áreas afins.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei fera em engenharia de dados, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a/e) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Domínio avançado em Python, SQL (manipulação, consulta e otimização), PySpark e conhecimentos sólidos em programação orientada a objetos (OOP), Clean Code e design patterns.
  • Experiência na criação de ETLs e pipelines de dados utilizando AWS Glue, EMR, StepFunction, além de expertise em ingestão, processamento de dados em tempo real (Kinesis), serverless (Lambda), S3, SQS, SNS e DynamoDB.
  • Vivência com provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e monitoramento de aplicações e infraestrutura (Datadog).
  • Experiência com versionamento com Git e implementação de políticas de governança de dados (segurança, controle de acesso e compliance).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL.


- Diferenciais:


  • Experiência prévia em projetos de Data Mesh.
  • Conhecimento em DataOps e automação de pipelines de dados.
  • Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Solutions Architect ou AWS Certified Data Analytics.
  • Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração de workflows.
  • Conhecimento em Apache Iceberg ou Delta Lake para gerenciamento de dados em lagos de dados.
  • Experiência em projetos de dados utilizando AWS.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.



WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base



REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.



WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability



READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.



Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de operações (AHTS)
description:
Pessoa Coordenadora de Operações (AHTS)


Sobre a CBO:

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e buscamos criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e seguro para todas e todos. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQIA+.


Descrição Resumida:


Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Operações para atuar na gestão de contratos e desempenho da frota offshore, com foco em embarcações do tipo AHTS. Será responsável por garantir a eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória, controle de custos e relacionamento com o cliente. Experiência direta com AHTS será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito eliminatório.


Descrição Detalhada:


1. Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos internos, contratuais e legais no desenvolvimento das operações, por meio do acompanhamento das atividades operacionais e da atuação no gerenciamento dos processos, incluindo estabelecimento de ações preventivas e corretivas;


2. Assegurar a manutenção da operacionalidade da frota de embarcações, por meio da participação nos processos de planejamento, decisão e interface com o cliente e interação com os departamentos de suporte quando necessário (suprimentos, manutenção, engenharia, QSMS e RH marítimo);


3. Aumentar a eficiência, rentabilidade e segurança da operação da frota de embarcações, por meio do acompanhamento dos indicadores de desempenho, da realização de análises críticas e indicação e desenvolvimento de projetos de melhorias para os processos, através do estreito relacionamento com o departamento de QSMS a fim de garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de segurança e procedimentos internos da companhia, assim como atuação no processo de investigação de acidentes;


4. Garantir atendimento e satisfação dos clientes, por meio de um bom relacionamento, conhecimento dos requisitos estabelecidos, acompanhamento dos índices de avaliação de desempenho, realização de análises críticas desses resultados e indicação de melhorias para os processos, assim como estar atento a tendência e projetos de melhoria para maior satisfação ao cliente;


5. Assegurar o cumprimento do orçamento de custos e receitas da gerência de operações, por meio da participação nos processos de orçamento, análise crítica dos resultados e indicação de ações preventivas e corretivas, assim como emissão de relatórios de medição do serviço e reembolso, acompanhamento do processo até o pagamento junto com o setor financeiro;


6. Preservar a saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e parceiros, bem como a preservação ambiental, no desenvolvimento das operações, por meio da participação nos processos de análise de riscos, definição de medidas de controle, elaboração de procedimentos e fornecimento de orientações;


7. Apoiar no desenvolvimento da equipe, por meio de planejamento e acompanhamento do Planejamento de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), a fim de conduzir o crescimento dentro da organização;


8. Assegurar retorno a operacionalidade das embarcações em situações de downtime, através de coordenação das necessidades da embarcação e negociação com cliente com o objetivo de reverter o downtime com a menor perda possível de faturamento, assim como a execução e envio de relatórios técnicos ao cliente;


9. Controlar e garantir atendimento das ações e pendências com o cliente e órgãos reguladores, acompanhamento do processo no sistema SISPEN, GINSP (PETROBRAS), controle de cartas, agrupando as informações de todas as áreas envolvidas;


10. Coordenar os projetos de conversão/modificação das embarcações para estejam de acordo com os requisitos contratados pelo cliente, planejando junto as áreas de apoio (Engenharia, Suprimentos e Docagem) todas as entregas relacionadas a projeto, materiais e obra da embarcação dentro do prazo e atendendo ao escopo solicitado;


11. Cumprir e implementar as determinações estabelecidas pela companhia, na busca da melhoria da Qualidade, Segurança (Ocupacional e Operacional), Saúde e Proteção Ambiental, prevenção e combate à poluição e/ou eliminação das não conformidades, visando a excelência operacional.


Requisitos necessários:

  • Formação superior completa (Engenharias, Náutica, Administração ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência anterior em operações offshore ou gestão de frotas marítimas;
  • Conhecimento sólido dos requisitos contratuais e regulatórios do setor;
  • Familiaridade com gestão de indicadores, orçamento e relacionamento com clientes;
  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes multidisciplinares, com foco em resultados e segurança


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência anterior com embarcações tipo AHTS

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.


Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes  Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.


Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

description:

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Certificada pelo 5° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a vaga

Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como a principal referência técnica na fase de concepção e desenho da arquitetura de uma nova solução de Inteligência Artificial para o setor financeiro. Você será fundamental na criação de uma ferramenta de IA que transformará a maneira como os clientes de um grande banco entendem e interagem com suas faturas de cartão de crédito.

O seu foco nos primeiros quatro meses será a fase de Discovery e Assessment Técnico. Você não irá apenas construir, mas sim projetar a fundação de todo o sistema , garantindo que a solução seja viável, segura, escalável e alinhada às mais modernas práticas de IA Generativa.


Responsabilidades

  • Análise de Viabilidade Técnica: Realizar uma análise profunda do ambiente tecnológico do cliente para mapear sistemas, APIs, restrições e dependências, garantindo que a implementação de uma solução baseada em LLMs seja segura e sustentável.
  • segura e sustentável.
  • Desenho da Arquitetura de IA: Liderar o desenho da arquitetura técnica completa para a solução agêntica. Isso inclui:
  • * Definição Estratégica e Seleção de Componentes: Avaliar, comparar e selecionar os componentes de IA mais adequados, incluindo o padrão de geração (RAG) , LLMs (ex: GPT, Gemini, Claude) , frameworks agênticos (ex: LangChain, CrewAI) , modelos de embedding e bancos de dados vetoriais.
  • * Desenho do Sistema de Ingestão de Dados: Projetar o pipeline para coletar, processar e vetorizar dados proprietários (como faturas), garantindo que o sistema RAG seja alimentado com informações precisas e atualizadas.
  • * Desenho da Camada de Orquestração: Definir como os componentes de IA se integrarão com a arquitetura do cliente e com os canais de frontend (App ou WhatsApp).
  • Estratégia de MLOps e Monitoramento: Definir a arquitetura e as ferramentas para o ciclo de vida completo da IA (LLMOps), incluindo monitoramento contínuo de performance, detecção de drift e rastreabilidade das interações do agente.
